subject: Show changes
body:
Hi Ben,

Jo paid the difference in reg fees and her show was changed to offer free tickets instead.

In regard to unticketed events, that is up to the venue to manage their capacity for these.

Many thanks,

Elin Eaton (she/her)
Box Office Manager
A: Office 4 at The Old Court House, 118 Church Street, Brighton, BN1 1UD
P: 01273 91 72 72
W: www.brightonfringe.org
notes: Confirms administrative change to show ticketing and venue responsibility for unticketed events.
